name: BITEZ - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Strawberry Watermelon
description:
Experience the delightful blend of flavors with our latest Double-Stacked BITEZ gummies! These artisanal treats combine the rich sweetness of strawberries with the lush taste of watermelon, all in one scrumptious gummy. Each gummy is expertly infused with a robust mix of Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP, delivering a total of 1,000mg per piece. Every pack comes with two of these exceptional, multi-layered delights, promising a deeply satisfying taste adventure with every bite.

Strawberry Watermelon layers juicy Strawberry with refreshing Watermelon flavor, packing 2,000mg per bag and 1,000mg per gummy. Each gummy features a potent blend of THCP, Delta-9, and Delta-8 for a stacked BITEZ experience.
